development_evidence.disclosure: v5 outcomes informed this changed protocol; v6 is prospective validation, not an ahistorical independent confirmation

design.scramble: position-specific SHA-256 digit permutation followed by base-specific digital digit shift

partition.domain_disclosure: all strata remain in the same declared L0 domain; exact coordinates and groups are untouched, but coarse spatial regions intentionally overlap prior same-domain work

model_selection.model_family: accepted ExactGP ARD Matern-5/2 with native input/output normalization
model_selection.unavailable_candidates: accepted runtime exposes no composite-kernel or transformed-output public fitting API
model_selection.selection: smallest budget passing all method-group point and interval stability gates; stop before final calibration and assessment if none passes

intervals.method_selection: equal-group-weight leave-one-group-out coverage stability then normalized width
intervals.final_method: cluster-weighted grouped split-conformal with exact rational finite-sample rank; each calibration group has equal mass and groups, not pooled rows, are the exchangeability unit

gates.acceptance: selected model passes method gates before calibration; final assessment passes every point and coverage gate in every stratum and overall

identity.execution: clean detached worktree at exact pushed preregistration commit
identity.runtime_closure: actual imported repository modules matched to HEAD Git blob IDs including package initializers
identity.exclusive_lock: retained atomic O_CREAT|O_EXCL lock in Git common directory

claims.allowed: prospective same-domain deterministic L0 software-emulation validation
claims.forbidden: ahistorical independence, untouched coarse regions, physical accuracy, or higher-fidelity accuracy
